package.description: Windows companion app for Home Assistant with notifications, media control, sensors and commands over MQTT or the Home Assistant API.

en-US.description: Windows companion app for Home Assistant with notifications, media control, sensors and commands over MQTT or the Home Assistant API.
en-US.longDescription:
HASS.Agent .NET10 connects a Windows PC to Home Assistant over MQTT or the Home Assistant WebSocket API.
It shows Home Assistant notifications as Windows notifications with pictures, buttons and text fields, exposes a media player, built-in and custom sensors, the display as a light, audio device selects, hotkeys as events, shutdown, restart and custom command buttons, and can be updated from Home Assistant.
A tray app handles the interactive features and an optional Windows service keeps sensors and commands working when nobody is logged in.
The matching Home Assistant integration is in the Home Assistant Marketplace (HACS before Home Assistant 2026.11).
en-US.name: HASS.Agent .NET10
